title: PS7-targeting scripts should start with #Requires -Version 7
symptoms: Cryptic parse errors when a PS7 script is run under Windows PowerShell 5.1
explanation: Scripts using PS7 syntax fail with cryptic parse errors under 5.1. A #Requires -Version 7.0 header fails fast with a clear message instead. Also note 5.1→7 behavior changes: no IE parsing engine in Invoke-WebRequest (.ParsedHtml gone); -eq remains case-insensitive (use -ceq when case matters).
